rule: W_total is TOTAL WORK: every executed step is charged at STEP_IR (the walk rows), whether it ends in a relation or in an abandoned trail; the only row outside them is the fresh trail start, charged ceil(S/L) x RESTART BY CONSTRUCTION because every trail is capped at L = 64 steps.  Nothing here is a probabilistic bound on a toy frequency.
success_denominator: S_eff = S: the budget is stated in EXECUTED steps and every one of them is charged, so the success model uses S and the waste is inside the charge instead of being added to it
withdrawn: v35 trap_abort_waste = ceil(4497*S/5040000) x (32*STEP_IR + RESTART): Markov does not turn an observed toy abort frequency into an upper bound, and the aborted window's steps were already charged in the walk rows (double charge).
